api.description: Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership owns and operates the 192 MW Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station on a diversion of the Mississippi River near Vidalia, Louisiana. The run-of-river facility entered service in 1990 and sells power to an Entergy utility and the Town of Vidalia under long-term arrangements extending through 2031. Brookfield Renewable affiliates hold the 75% economic balance and the managing/control position. ArcLight Capital Partners holds the remaining 25% through ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P., which acquired the interest from ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V on July 8, 2021. The project company is the single PortCo; its upstream holdcos, co-licensee and lenders are not separate owners.

BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Catalyst Old River Hydroelectric Limited Partnership owns and operates the 192 MW Sidney A.

Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station on a diversion of the Mississippi River near Vidalia, Louisiana. The run-of-river facility entered service in 1990 and sells power to an Entergy utility and the Town of Vidalia under long-term arrangements extending through 2031. Brookfield Renewable affiliates hold the 75% economic balance and the managing/control position. ArcLight Capital Partners holds the remaining 25% through ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P., which acquired the interest from ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V on July 8, 2021. The project company is the single PortCo; its upstream holdcos, co-licensee and lenders are not separate owners.

STORY TIMELINE
Jul 8, 2021
Investment

ArcLight Renewable Infrastructure Fund SM SPV, L.P. acquired a 25% interest in the project from ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V, L.P.

2021

ArcLight Capital Partners

Prudential Private Capital provided $60 million of senior-secured debt to Rougaroux Power Holdings to recapitalize the non-managing interest in the hydro project; the financing did not create a separate equity owner.

ArcLight Energy Partners Fund V acquired its initial interest in the Sidney Murray hydro project.

1990
Expansion

The 192 MW Sidney A. Murray Jr. Hydroelectric Station entered commercial operation near Vidalia, Louisiana.
